name: tripcash
description: Group trip expense splitter: shared web app with Capacitor iOS and Android wrappers.

scripts.check: node --check web/scripts/app.js && node --check web/scripts/web-shell.js && node --check web/scripts/web-dashboard.js && node --check web/scripts/web-workspace.js && node --check web/scripts/web-expense.js && node --check web/scripts/native-redesign.js && node --check web/scripts/auth.js && node --check web/scripts/admin.js && node --check web/scripts/admin-client.js && node --check web/scripts/supabase.js && node --check web/scripts/offline.js && node --check web/scripts/landing.js && node --check web/scripts/auth-callback.js && node --check functions/native-captcha.js && node --check functions/api/contact.js && node --check functions/api/welcome.js && node --check functions/api/account-closure.js && node --check functions/api/receipt-scan.js && node --check web/scripts/analytics.js && node --check scripts/build-web.mjs && node --check scripts/fix-ios-package-paths.mjs && node --check scripts/run-android-gradle.mjs && node --check scripts/run-supabase-integration.mjs && node --check scripts/seed-android-screenshot-demo.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && node --test
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build:native && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/fix-ios-package-paths.mjs && npm run build
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run build:native && npx cap sync android && npm run build
